title: G32: audit public cutover ordering and draft exact-version corrections
public_pr_body:
Read 458 unique public document versions: main, pinned public 9d7725e, documentation changes across all 244 open public PR heads/pages at cutoff, and all 19 Word copies. No private files or evidence archives read. The inventory pins every read document/hash; closed/merged historical branches are outside this explicitly stated corpus.

Adds 32 exact-source draft patches and a 157-row file/line/old-text/new-wording table. These are sequence references needing context/refresh, not 157 independent runtime bugs. Patches add a controlling 138 → 140 → 141 → 144 → 145 → 146 → 147 order and explicitly mark older sequences historical, retaining original gates/evidence. Alternate patches for the same path are version-specific, not cumulative; none was applied to another owner's branch.

Required dependencies: releases verified in order, approved JNR wipe, retained-record/Marpet/numbering-hold checks. Proposed explicit remaining positions: authorised SliQ dry run/load/reconciliation while numbering holds remain, retained-state recheck, DLN counter and independent verification, approved app deployment and staff smoke checks. Rhys must adopt the import/deployment positions before operations; no authorisation is inferred here.

Three offline tests passed, zero skipped: pinned inventory, finding/patch coverage and git-apply of every patch against exact captured public source. No SQL, wipe, import or deployment ran. Source whitespace checked; patch context bytes retained. Handover: docs/audit/G32-CUTOVER-ORDER-REVIEW.md.

G32: public review/patch draft done; 3 checks passed. From main, docs/tests only; no merge, production SQL, private files, #359/go-live edits or message to John.
